	createModes = payload['createModes']
	createStates = payload['createStates']
	createItems = payload['createItems']
	
	if payload['oldPath'] != payload['newPath']:
		system.perspective.print('Updating assetPath')
		newParts = []
		oldParts = []
		
		newSplit = payload['newPath'].split('\\')
		oldSplit = payload['oldPath'].split('\\')
		
		pathSplitter = '**|**'
		pathBackSlash = '\\\\'
		
		eData = str(system.util.jsonEncode(self.custom.data))
		eData = eData.replace(pathBackSlash, pathSplitter)
		
		for i in range(len(oldSplit)):
			newParts.append(newSplit[i]) 
			oldParts.append(oldSplit[i])
			
			newName = newParts[-1]
			oldName = oldParts[-1]
			
			newPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [newName])
			oldPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [oldName])
			
			system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldPath, newPath))
			eData = eData.replace('"assetPath":"%s'%oldPath, '"assetPath":"%s'%newPath)			
			
			if oldName != newName:
				system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldName, newName))
				eData = eData.replace('"assetName":"%s"'%oldName, '"assetName":"%s"'%newName)
	
		eData = eData.replace(pathSplitter, pathBackSlash)
		
		data = system.util.jsonDecode(eData)
	else:
		data = self.custom.data
	
	self.saveImport(data, createModes, createStates, createItems)
	
	return

customMethods.name: importAsset_ORIG
customMethods.script:
'''
		Imports all config info includes child assets, links to modes, states, items and attributes (kanoaOPS)
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
			createModes: bool - Should the modes be created?
			createStates: bool - Should the states be created?
			createItems: bool - Should the items be created?
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Updated:
			tmp 04/12/24
			tmp 04/30/24: Added fix for assetType and duplicate mode names
			tmp 07/01/24: Added a check condition in the add attribute loop to see if the attribute is for the current asset
			jfc 8/25/25 6:01pm: addAsset() now returns a tuple
			jfc 8/28/25 6:31pm: Fixed issue with assetGroups
			JZ  02/12/26: Adding initial check for asset types
	'''
	
	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaAssetImporter')
	log.info("importAsset() called by %s"%(userId))
	
	sendUpdateMsg = True if (msgHandler or None) is not None else False
	
	def displayMessage(msg):
		if sendUpdateMsg: system.perspective.sendMessage(msgHandler, {'text': msg})
		system.perspective.print(msg)
		log.info(msg)
		return
		
	import java.lang
	
	try:
		exportInfo = system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)
		exportInfo.replace('\\\\', '\\')	
		exportInfo = system.util.jsonDecode(exportInfo)
		
		# Checking to see that imported assets contain asset types that don't exist on the target gateway
		importAssetTypes = list(set([row['assetTypePath'] for row in exportInfo['assets']]))
		gatewayAssetTypes = list(set([row['assetTypePath'] for row in system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({})]))
		notFoundTypes = [assetType for assetType in importAssetTypes if assetType not in gatewayAssetTypes]
			
		if len(notFoundTypes):
			errorMsg = "Assets could not be imported as they are linked to asset types that do not exist on this system. Please create the following asset types and then import the assets..."
			notFoundTypes.insert(0, errorMsg)
			system.perspective.openPopup('importAssetError', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/loggingPopup', params={'popupId': 'importAssetError', 'logs': notFoundTypes}, draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, title='Asset Types Not Found')			
			return {'passed': False, 'message': errorMsg}			
			
		roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
		
		if not 'assets' in exportInfo: return {'passed': False, 'message': 'No assets in exported info'}
		assets = sorted(exportInfo['assets'], key=lambda x: (len(x['assetPath'].split('\\')), x['sortOrder']))
		
		# add state Type data		
		stateTypeIds = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getStateType({}), 'stateTypeName', 'stateTypeId')
		
		# add state category data
		stateCategoryIds = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getStateCategory({}), 'stateCategoryPath', 'stateCategoryId')
		stateCategories = exportInfo['stateCategories']
		for stateCategory in stateCategories:
			if stateCategory['stateCategoryName'] is None: continue
			SCSections = stateCategory['stateCategoryPath'].split('\\')
			SCPaths = ['\\'.join(SCSections[:index+1]) for index in range(len(SCSections))]
			for SCPath in SCPaths:
				if stateCategoryIds.has_key(SCPath): continue
				parentPath = '\\'.join(SCPath.split('\\')[:-1]) if len(SCPath.split('\\')) > 1 else None
				newSCName = SCPath.split('\\')[-1]
				newSCInfo = {'stateCategoryName': newSCName, 'parentId': None, 'enabled': True}
				if parentPath is not None and stateCategoryIds.has_key(parentPath): newSCInfo['parentId'] = stateCategoryIds[parentPath]
				newStateCategoryId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addStateCategory(newSCInfo, userId)
				stateCategoryIds[SCPath] = newStateCategoryId
		
		# add asset group data
		assetGroupIds = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetGroups({}), 'assetGroupName', 'assetGroupId')
		assetGroups = exportInfo['assetGroups']		
		for assetGroup in assetGroups:
			if assetGroup['assetGroupName'] is None: continue
			if not assetGroupIds.has_key(assetGroup['assetGroupName']):
				assetGroupIds[assetGroup['assetGroupName']] = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(assetGroup['assetGroupName'], userId)
#				log.info("Added assetGroup %s. Id is %s"%(assetGroup['assetGroupName'], assetGroupIds[assetGroup['assetGroupName']]))				
		
		# add item and item classes
		itemClassPaths = {}
		for rateInfo in exportInfo['assetRates']:
			classPathParts = []
			
			if rateInfo['itemClassPath'] is None: continue
			for part in rateInfo['itemClassPath'].split('\\'):
				classPathParts.append(part)		
				classPath = '\\'.join(classPathParts)
				if classPath in itemClassPaths: continue
				itemClassPaths[classPath] = {'itemClassPath': classPath, 'itemClassColor': rateInfo['itemClassColor'] if classPath == rateInfo['itemClassPath'] else None}
		
		for itemClassInfo in sorted(itemClassPaths.values(), key=lambda x: x['itemClassPath']):
			itemClassId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': itemClassInfo['itemClassPath']}))
			if itemClassId: continue
			
			pathSplit = itemClassInfo['itemClassPath'].split('\\')
			parentPath = '\\'.join(pathSplit[:-1]) if len(pathSplit) > 1 else None
			parentId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': parentPath})) if parentPath else None		
			itemClassInfo = {'itemClassName': pathSplit[-1], 'parentId': parentId, 'itemClassDescription': None, 'itemClassColor': itemClassInfo['itemClassColor'], 'enabled': True}		
			system.kanoa.item.addItemClass(itemClassInfo, userId)
		
		# add assets
		for i, asset in enumerate(assets):
			displayMessage('importing asset %s'%asset['assetPath'])
			parentPath = '\\'.join(asset['assetPath'].split('\\')[:-1]) or None
		
			asset['parentId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({ 'assetPath': parentPath })) if parentPath else None
			asset['assetId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({ 'assetPath': asset['assetPath'] }))
		
			if asset['assetId'] is None:
				assetTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetTypeId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({'assetTypePath': asset['assetTypePath']}))
				if assetTypeId is None: return {'passed': False, 'message': 'Asset type does not exist'} 
				asset['assetTypeId'] = assetTypeId
				
				if asset['assetGroupName'] is not None:
					if not assetGroupIds.has_key(asset['assetGroupName']): assetGroupIds[asset['assetGroupName']] = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(asset['assetGroupName'], userId)
						
					asset['assetGroupId'] = assetGroupIds[asset['assetGroupName']]
				
				assetId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addAsset(asset, userId)
				if msg: return {'passed': False, 'message': msg}
				
				assetSortOrder = asset['sortOrder']
				if assetSortOrder is not None: self.updateSortOrder(asset['parentId'])				
				if i == 0: system.kanoa.security.addUserAssetRole({'assetId': assetId, 'roleId': roleId, 'userId': userId}, userId) # we only need to add the user asset role to the root asset. 
				
				# add attributes
				for attribute in exportInfo['attributes']:
					if attribute['assetPath'] == asset['assetPath']:
						newAttributeId = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetAttribute(assetId, attribute['assetAttrName'], attribute['assetAttrValue'], userId)
				
				# add modes
				if createModes:
					assetModes = exportInfo['modes']
					modeIdList = []
					modeCodeList = []
					autoScheduleList = []
					MASMap = {}
					
					for modeInfo in assetModes:
						if modeInfo['assetPath'] != asset['assetPath']: continue
						modeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeId', system.kanoa.asset.getModes({ 'modeName': modeInfo['modeName'] }))
						
						if modeId is None:
							modeInfo['modeTypeId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeTypeId', system.kanoa.asset.getModeTypes({ 'modeTypeName': modeInfo['modeTypeName'] }))
							displayMessage('adding mode %s'%modeInfo['modeName'])
							modeId = system.kanoa.asset.addMode(modeInfo, userId)
						
						modeIdList.append(modeId)
						modeCodeList.append(modeInfo['modeCode'])
						autoScheduleList.append(modeInfo['autoSchedule'])
						MASMap[modeInfo['modeCode']] = modeInfo['autoSchedule']
					
					displayMessage('linking asset modes %s'%modeIdList)
					
					system.kanoa.asset.linkAssetModes([assetId], modeIdList, userId, modeCodeList)
					newAssetModes = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': assetId})
					newAssetModeLinks = [{'modeAssetLinkId': row['modeAssetLinkId'], 'modeId': row['modeId'], 'modeCode': row['modeCode'], 'autoSchedule': row['autoSchedule']} for row in newAssetModes]
					for nAMLink in newAssetModeLinks: system.kanoa.asset.updateAssetModeField(nAMLink['modeAssetLinkId'], 'autoSchedule', MASMap[nAMLink['modeCode']], userId)
					
				# add states
				if createStates:
					assetStates = exportInfo['states']
					stateIdList = []
					stateCodeList = []
					unknownStateCodeList = [9999]
					
					for stateInfo in assetStates:
						if stateInfo['assetPath'] != asset['assetPath']: continue
						stateId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateId', system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateName': stateInfo['stateName'], 'stateTypeName': stateInfo['stateTypeName'] }))
						if stateId is None:
							if stateInfo['stateTypeName'] is not None: stateInfo['stateTypeId'] = stateTypeIds[stateInfo['stateTypeName']]
							if stateInfo['stateCategoryName'] is not None: 
								stateInfo['stateCategoryId'] = stateCategoryIds[stateInfo['stateCategoryPath']]													
							stateInfo['assetGroupId'] = assetGroupIds[stateInfo['stateAssetGroupName']] if stateInfo['stateAssetGroupName'] is not None else None
								
							displayMessage('adding state %s'%stateInfo['stateName'])
							stateId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addState(stateInfo, userId)
						
						stateIdList.append(stateId)
						if stateInfo['stateCode'] is None:
							stateInfo['stateCode'] = max(unknownStateCodeList) + 1
							unknownStateCodeList.append(stateInfo['stateCode'])
						stateCodeList.append(stateInfo['stateCode'])
					
					displayMessage('linking asset states %s'%stateIdList)
					system.kanoa.asset.linkAssetStates([assetId], stateIdList, userId, stateCodeList)
			
				# add rates
				if createItems:
					assetRates = exportInfo['assetRates']
					
					for rateInfo in assetRates:				
						if rateInfo['assetPath'] != asset['assetPath']: continue
						rateInfo['itemId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({ 'itemName': rateInfo['itemName'] }))
						
						if rateInfo['itemId'] is None:
							rateInfo['itemClassId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({ 'itemClassPath': rateInfo['itemClassPath'] }))
							rateInfo ['enabled'] = True
							displayMessage('adding item %s'%rateInfo['itemName'])
							rateInfo['itemId'] = system.kanoa.item.addItem(rateInfo, userId)
						
						if rateInfo['itemPeriodId']: 
							rateInfo['itemPeriodId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemPeriodId', system.kanoa.item.getItemPeriod({ 'itemPeriodName': rateInfo['itemPeriodName'] }))
							if not rateInfo['itemPeriodId']: 
								displayMessage("adding %s"%rateInfo['itemPeriodName'])
								rateInfo['itemPeriodId'] = system.kanoa.item.addItemPeriod({'itemPeriodName': rateInfo['itemPeriodName'], 'enabled': True}, userId)
						
						if rateInfo['infeedUnitId']: 
							rateInfo['infeedUnitId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('infeedUnitId', system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({ 'infeedUnitName': rateInfo['infeedUnits'] }))
							if not rateInfo['infeedUnitId']: 
								infeedUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(rateInfo['infeedUnits'], userId)
								if msg is None: rateInfo['infeedUnitId'] = infeedUnitId
						
						if rateInfo['outfeedUnitId']: 
							rateInfo['outfeedUnitId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('outfeedUnitId', system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({ 'outfeedUnitName': rateInfo['outfeedUnits'] }))
							if not rateInfo['outfeedUnitId']: 
								outfeedUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(rateInfo['outfeedUnits'], userId)
								if msg is None: rateInfo['outfeedUnitId'] = outfeedUnitId
						
						if rateInfo['wasteUnitId']: 
							rateInfo['wasteUnitId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('wasteUnitId', system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({ 'wasteUnitName': rateInfo['wasteUnits'] }))
							if not rateInfo['wasteUnitId']: 
								wasteUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(rateInfo['wasteUnits'], userId)
								if msg is None: rateInfo['wasteUnitId'] = wasteUnitId
						
						rateInfo['assetId'] = assetId
						rateInfo['enabled'] = rateInfo['assetRateEnabled']
						
						displayMessage('adding item rate %s'%rateInfo['itemName'])
						system.kanoa.item.addItemAssetRate(rateInfo, userId)
						
	except java.lang.Exception, e:
		return {'passed': False, 'message': e.cause}
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Assets imported'}

'''
		Imports all config info includes child assets, links to modes, states, items and attributes
		Args:
			exportInfo: dict
			userId: int
			createModes: bool - Should the modes be created?
			createStates: bool - Should the states be created?
			createItems: bool - Should the items be created?
		Returns:
			success: bit
			msg: string
		Optimized:
			- Pre-groups imported rows by assetPath
			- Caches gateway lookups to avoid repeated DB/gateway calls
			- Defers sort-order updates until the end
			- Reduces repeated scans of exportInfo collections
	'''

	log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaAssetImporter')
	log.info("importAsset() called by %s" % (userId))
	timeNow = system.date.now()
	
	sendUpdateMsg = msgHandler is not None
	
	def displayMessage(msg):
		if sendUpdateMsg: system.perspective.sendMessage(msgHandler, {'text': msg})
		system.perspective.print(msg)
		log.info(msg)
		return
	
	def groupByAssetPath(rows):
		grouped = {}
		for row in rows or []:
			assetPath = row.get('assetPath')
			if assetPath is None: continue
			grouped.setdefault(assetPath, []).append(row)
		return grouped
	
	def dsToRows(ds):
		if ds is None: 	return []
		pyData = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(ds)
		cols = list(pyData.columnNames)
		return [dict((col, row[col]) for col in cols) for row in pyData]
	
	def buildLookup(rows, keyField, valueField):
		lookup = {}
		for row in rows:
			key = row.get(keyField)
			val = row.get(valueField)
			if key is not None: lookup[key] = val
		return lookup
		
	def normalizePath(path):
		return unicode(path).replace('\\\\', '\\').strip() if path else path
	
	import java.lang
	
	try:
		# normalize exportInfo
		exportInfo = system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)
		exportInfo.replace('\\\\', '\\')	
		exportInfo = system.util.jsonDecode(exportInfo)
		
		if 'assets' not in exportInfo:
			msg = 'No assets in exported info'
			displayMessage(msg)
			return {'passed': False, 'message': msg}
		
		# ===== Pre-group imported data =====
		attributesByAsset = groupByAssetPath(exportInfo.get('attributes', []))
		modesByAsset = groupByAssetPath(exportInfo.get('modes', []))
		statesByAsset = groupByAssetPath(exportInfo.get('states', []))
		ratesByAsset = groupByAssetPath(exportInfo.get('assetRates', []))
		
		# ===== Validate asset types early =====
		importAssetTypes = list(set([normalizePath(row.get('assetTypePath')) for row in exportInfo['assets'] if row.get('assetTypePath')]))
		
		assetTypeRows = dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({}))
		system.perspective.print("assetTypeRows - %s"%assetTypeRows)
		assetTypeIdByPath = {normalizePath(row.get('assetTypePath')): row['assetTypeId'] for row in assetTypeRows if row.get('assetTypePath')}	
		system.perspective.print("assetTypeIdByPath %s - %s"%assetTypeIdByPath)
		notFoundTypes = [assetType for assetType in importAssetTypes if assetType not in assetTypeIdByPath]		
	
		if len(notFoundTypes):
			errorMsg = "Assets could not be imported as they are linked to asset types that do not exist on this system. Please create the following asset types and then import the assets..."
			notFoundTypes.insert(0, errorMsg)
			system.perspective.openPopup('importAssetError', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/loggingPopup', params={'popupId': 'importAssetError', 'logs': notFoundTypes}, draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, title='Asset Types Not Found')
			return {'passed': False, 'message': errorMsg}
		
		roleId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('roleId', system.kanoa.security.getRoles({'roleName': 'Administrator'}))
		
		# ===== Sort assets by depth, then sortOrder =====
		assets = sorted(exportInfo['assets'], key=lambda x: (len(x['assetPath'].split('\\')), x['sortOrder']))
		
		# ===== Static lookups =====
		stateTypeIds = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getStateType({}), 'stateTypeName', 'stateTypeId')
		
		stateCategoryRows = dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getStateCategory({}))
		stateCategoryIds = buildLookup(stateCategoryRows, 'stateCategoryPath', 'stateCategoryId')
		
		assetGroupRows = dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetGroups({}))
		assetGroupIds = buildLookup(assetGroupRows, 'assetGroupName', 'assetGroupId')
		
		itemClassRows = dsToRows(system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({}))
		itemClassIdByPath = buildLookup(itemClassRows, 'itemClassPath', 'itemClassId')
		
		existingAssetRows = dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({}))
		assetIdByPath = buildLookup(existingAssetRows, 'assetPath', 'assetId')
		
		# Build mode cache
		modeIdByName = {row['modeName']: row['modeId'] for row in dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getModes({})) if row.get('modeName')}
		
		# Build state cache
		stateIdByKey = {(row.get('stateName'), row.get('stateTypeName')): row.get('stateId') for row in dsToRows(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({})) if row.get('stateName') is not None}
		
		# Build item cache
		itemIdByName = {row['itemName']: row['itemId'] for row in dsToRows(system.kanoa.item.getItems({})) if row.get('itemName') is not None}
		
		# Build item period cache
		itemPeriodIdByName = {row['itemPeriodName']: row['itemPeriodId'] for row in dsToRows(system.kanoa.item.getItemPeriod({})) if row.get('itemPeriodName') is not None}
		
		# Build item unit cache
		itemUnitIdByName = {row.get('itemUnitName'): row.get('itemUnitId') for row in dsToRows(system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({})) if row.get('itemUnitName')}
		
		# ===== Create missing state categories =====
		for stateCategory in exportInfo.get('stateCategories', []):
			if stateCategory.get('stateCategoryName') is None: continue
			
			SCSections = stateCategory['stateCategoryPath'].split('\\')
			SCPaths = ['\\'.join(SCSections[:index + 1]) for index in range(len(SCSections))]
			
			for SCPath in SCPaths:
				if SCPath in stateCategoryIds: continue
				
				parentPath = '\\'.join(SCPath.split('\\')[:-1]) if len(SCPath.split('\\')) > 1 else None
				newSCName = SCPath.split('\\')[-1]
				newSCInfo = {'stateCategoryName': newSCName, 'parentId': stateCategoryIds.get(parentPath), 'enabled': True}
				newStateCategoryId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addStateCategory(newSCInfo, userId)
				stateCategoryIds[SCPath] = newStateCategoryId
		
		# ===== Create missing asset groups =====
		for assetGroup in exportInfo.get('assetGroups', []):
			assetGroupName = assetGroup.get('assetGroupName')
			if assetGroupName is None: continue
			if assetGroupName not in assetGroupIds: assetGroupIds[assetGroupName] = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(assetGroupName, userId)
		
		# ===== Create missing item classes =====
		itemClassPaths = {}
		for rateInfo in exportInfo.get('assetRates', []):
			itemClassPath = rateInfo.get('itemClassPath')
			if itemClassPath is None: continue
			
			classPathParts = []
			for part in itemClassPath.split('\\'):
				classPathParts.append(part)
				classPath = '\\'.join(classPathParts)
				if classPath not in itemClassPaths: itemClassPaths[classPath] = {'itemClassPath': classPath, 'itemClassColor': rateInfo.get('itemClassColor') if classPath == itemClassPath else None}
		
		for itemClassInfo in sorted(itemClassPaths.values(), key=lambda x: x['itemClassPath']):
			classPath = itemClassInfo['itemClassPath']
			if classPath in itemClassIdByPath: continue
			
			pathSplit = classPath.split('\\')
			parentPath = '\\'.join(pathSplit[:-1]) if len(pathSplit) > 1 else None
			parentId = itemClassIdByPath.get(parentPath)
			
			newItemClassInfo = {'itemClassName': pathSplit[-1], 'parentId': parentId, 'itemClassDescription': None, 'itemClassColor': itemClassInfo['itemClassColor'], 'enabled': True}
			system.kanoa.item.addItemClass(newItemClassInfo, userId)
			
			# refresh cache only for the created path
			newId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({'itemClassPath': classPath}))
			itemClassIdByPath[classPath] = newId
		
		# ===== Import assets =====
		parentsNeedingSort = set()
		rootAssetCreated = False
		pendingAssetStateLinks = []
		pendingAssetModeLinks = []
		
		for i, asset in enumerate(assets):
			assetPath = asset['assetPath']
			displayMessage('importing asset %s' % assetPath)
			
			parentPath = '\\'.join(assetPath.split('\\')[:-1]) or None
			parentId = assetIdByPath.get(parentPath)
			existingAssetId = assetIdByPath.get(assetPath)
			
			asset['parentId'] = parentId
			asset['assetId'] = existingAssetId
			
			if existingAssetId is None:
				assetTypeId = assetTypeIdByPath.get(asset.get('assetTypePath'))
				if assetTypeId is None: return {'passed': False, 'message': 'Asset type does not exist'}
				
				asset['assetTypeId'] = assetTypeId
				
				assetGroupName = asset.get('assetGroupName')
				if assetGroupName is not None:
					if assetGroupName not in assetGroupIds: assetGroupIds[assetGroupName] = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(assetGroupName, userId)
					asset['assetGroupId'] = assetGroupIds[assetGroupName]
				
				assetId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addAsset(asset, userId)
				if msg: return {'passed': False, 'message': msg}
				
				assetIdByPath[assetPath] = assetId
				
				if asset.get('sortOrder') is not None and parentId is not None: parentsNeedingSort.add(parentId)
				
				if not rootAssetCreated:
					system.kanoa.security.addUserAssetRole({'assetId': assetId, 'roleId': roleId, 'userId': userId}, userId)
					rootAssetCreated = True
			else:
				assetId = existingAssetId
			
			# ===== add attributes =====
			for attribute in attributesByAsset.get(assetPath, []):
				system.kanoa.asset.addAssetAttribute(assetId, attribute['assetAttrName'], attribute['assetAttrValue'], userId)
			
			# ===== add modes =====
			if createModes:
				for modeInfo in modesByAsset.get(assetPath, []):
					modeName = modeInfo.get('modeName')
					modeId = modeIdByName.get(modeName)
					
					if modeId is None:
						modeInfo['modeTypeId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeTypeId', system.kanoa.asset.getModeTypes({'modeTypeName': modeInfo['modeTypeName']}))
						displayMessage('adding mode %s' % modeName)
						modeId = system.kanoa.asset.addMode(modeInfo, userId)
						modeIdByName[modeName] = modeId
					
					pendingAssetModeLinks.append({'assetId': assetId, 'modeId': modeId, 'modeCode': modeInfo.get('modeCode'), 'autoSchedule': modeInfo.get('autoSchedule')})
			
			# ===== add states =====
			if createStates:
				stateIdList = []
				stateCodeList = []
				unknownStateCodeList = [9999]
				
				for stateInfo in statesByAsset.get(assetPath, []):
					key = (stateInfo.get('stateName'), stateInfo.get('stateTypeName'))
					stateId = stateIdByKey.get(key)
					
					if stateId is None:
						if stateInfo.get('stateTypeName') is not None: stateInfo['stateTypeId'] = stateTypeIds[stateInfo['stateTypeName']]
						if stateInfo.get('stateCategoryName') is not None: stateInfo['stateCategoryId'] = stateCategoryIds[stateInfo['stateCategoryPath']]
						
						stateAssetGroupName = stateInfo.get('stateAssetGroupName')
						stateInfo['assetGroupId'] = assetGroupIds[stateAssetGroupName] if stateAssetGroupName is not None else None
						
						displayMessage('adding state %s' % stateInfo['stateName'])
						stateId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addState(stateInfo, userId)
						stateIdByKey[key] = stateId
					
					stateIdList.append(stateId)
					
					if stateInfo.get('stateCode') is None:
						stateInfo['stateCode'] = max(unknownStateCodeList) + 1
						unknownStateCodeList.append(stateInfo['stateCode'])
					
					stateCodeList.append(stateInfo['stateCode'])

				if len(stateIdList):
					displayMessage('queueing asset states %s' % stateIdList)
					for idx, stateId in enumerate(stateIdList):
						if stateId is None: continue
						pendingAssetStateLinks.append({'assetId': assetId, 'stateId': stateId, 'stateCode': stateCodeList[idx] if idx < len(stateCodeList) else None})
			
			# ===== add rates / items =====
			if createItems:
				for rateInfo in ratesByAsset.get(assetPath, []):
					itemName = rateInfo.get('itemName')
					itemId = itemIdByName.get(itemName)
					
					if itemId is None:
						itemClassPath = rateInfo.get('itemClassPath')
						rateInfo['itemClassId'] = itemClassIdByPath.get(itemClassPath)
						rateInfo['enabled'] = True
						displayMessage('adding item %s' % itemName)
						itemId = system.kanoa.item.addItem(rateInfo, userId)
						itemIdByName[itemName] = itemId
					
					rateInfo['itemId'] = itemId
					
					itemPeriodName = rateInfo.get('itemPeriodName')
					if itemPeriodName:
						itemPeriodId = itemPeriodIdByName.get(itemPeriodName)
						if not itemPeriodId:
							displayMessage("adding %s" % itemPeriodName)
							itemPeriodId = system.kanoa.item.addItemPeriod({'itemPeriodName': itemPeriodName, 'enabled': True}, userId)
							itemPeriodIdByName[itemPeriodName] = itemPeriodId
						rateInfo['itemPeriodId'] = itemPeriodId
					
					infeedUnits = rateInfo.get('infeedUnits')
					if infeedUnits:
						infeedUnitId = itemUnitIdByName.get(infeedUnits)
						if not infeedUnitId:
							infeedUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(infeedUnits, userId)
							if msg is None: itemUnitIdByName[infeedUnits] = infeedUnitId
						rateInfo['infeedUnitId'] = infeedUnitId
					
					outfeedUnits = rateInfo.get('outfeedUnits')
					if outfeedUnits:
						outfeedUnitId = itemUnitIdByName.get(outfeedUnits)
						if not outfeedUnitId:
							outfeedUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(outfeedUnits, userId)
							if msg is None: itemUnitIdByName[outfeedUnits] = outfeedUnitId
						rateInfo['outfeedUnitId'] = outfeedUnitId
					
					wasteUnits = rateInfo.get('wasteUnits')
					if wasteUnits:
						wasteUnitId = itemUnitIdByName.get(wasteUnits)
						if not wasteUnitId:
							wasteUnitId, msg = system.kanoa.item.addItemUnit(wasteUnits, userId)
							if msg is None: itemUnitIdByName[wasteUnits] = wasteUnitId
						rateInfo['wasteUnitId'] = wasteUnitId
					
					rateInfo['assetId'] = assetId
					rateInfo['enabled'] = rateInfo['assetRateEnabled']
					
					displayMessage('adding item rate %s' % itemName)
					system.kanoa.item.addItemAssetRate(rateInfo, userId)
		
		# ===== Deferred sort updates =====
		for parentId in parentsNeedingSort:
			self.updateSortOrder(parentId)
			
		if pendingAssetStateLinks:
			displayMessage('linking %s asset state rows' % len(pendingAssetStateLinks))
			system.kanoa.asset.upsertAssetStateLinks(pendingAssetStateLinks, userId)
			
		if pendingAssetModeLinks:
			displayMessage('linking %s asset modes' % len(pendingAssetModeLinks))
			system.kanoa.asset.upsertAssetModeLinks(pendingAssetModeLinks, userId)
	
	except java.lang.Exception, e:
		return {'passed': False, 'message': e.cause}
	except Exception, e:
		return {'passed': False, 'message': str(e)}
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showToast', {'message': 'Asset Import completed in %i seconds'%system.date.secondsBetween(timeNow, system.date.now())})
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'Assets imported'}

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('saveSchedAttributes called with: %s'%(str(self.view.custom.assetInfo)))
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	keys = ['shiftTimeOnly', 'orderQtySelection', 'intelligentScheduling']
	schedAttrs = self.view.custom.assetInfo
	for attr in keys:
		attrInfo = schedAttrs[attr]
		attrValue = int(attrInfo['value'])
		system.perspective.print('looking at attr %s with value of %s'%(attr, attrValue))
		
		if attrInfo['assetAttrId'] is None and attrInfo['inherited']: continue #Nothing to do here
		elif attrInfo['assetAttrId'] is None and not attrInfo['inherited']: #Need to add a production day for this asset
			system.perspective.print("calling addAssetAttribute() with %s %s %s %s"%(assetId, '_' + attr, attrValue, userId))
			assetAttributeId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetAttribute(assetId, '_' + attr, attrValue, userId)
		elif attrInfo['assetAttrId'] is not None and not attrInfo['inherited']:
			system.perspective.print("calling deleteAssetAttribute()")
			system.kanoa.asset.deleteAssetAttribute(attrInfo['assetAttrId'], userId)
			system.perspective.print("calling addAssetAttribute() with %s %s %s %s"%(assetId, '_' + attr, attrValue, userId))
			assetAttributeId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetAttribute(assetId, '_' + attr, attrValue, userId)
		elif attrInfo['assetAttrId'] is not None and attrInfo['inherited']:
			system.perspective.print("calling deleteAssetAttribute()")
			system.kanoa.asset.deleteAssetAttribute(attrInfo['assetAttrId'], userId)
	
	return

system.perspective.print("refreshAssets msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assets.data")
	
	return

system.perspective.print("deleteAssetHistory msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	if payload.has_key('userInput') and payload['userInput'] == 'OK':
		assetId = payload['inputPayload']['assetId']
		self.deleteAssetsWithForce(assetId)
	
	return

#	system.perspective.print("assetDropped() msg rcvd with draggedItem %s | droppedItem %s"%(payload['draggedItem']['assetPath'], payload['droppedItem']['assetPath']))
	assetPath = payload['draggedItem']['assetPath']
	if assetPath is None: return
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate:
		system.perspective.print("User action not allowed. sending refreshTreeSelector() msg")
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'User action not allowed'})
		return
			
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem'] if payload['droppedItem'] is not None else {'parentId': None, 'assetId': None, 'assetPath': 'root level'}

	system.perspective.print("draggedItem['parentId'] - %sdraggedItem['assetId'] - %s droppedItem['parentId'] - %s"%(draggedItem['parentId'], draggedItem['assetId'], droppedItem['parentId']))
	
	if draggedItem['parentId'] == droppedItem['assetId']: #User has dropped the asset onto its parent. We'll set the sortOrder of this asset to 0
		system.perspective.print("User has dropped the asset onto its parent. We'll set the sortOrder of this asset to 0")
		self.updateAssetSortOrder(draggedItem, droppedItem)
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
		self.selectAsset(draggedItem['assetId'])
	elif draggedItem['parentId'] and draggedItem['parentId'] == droppedItem['parentId'] and draggedItem['assetTypeId'] == droppedItem['assetTypeId']: #User has dropped the asset onto a sibling. Either we re-order or move
		system.perspective.print("#User has dropped the asset onto a sibling. Either we re-order or move")
		self.updateAssetSortOrder(draggedItem, droppedItem)
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
		self.selectAsset(draggedItem['assetId'])
	else:
		system.perspective.print("#User has moved the asset")
		assetPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(assetPath, {})
		parentPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(droppedItem['assetPath'], {})
		msg = "Are you sure you want to move %s to %s"%(assetPath, parentPath)
		system.perspective.openPopup('moveAsset', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'confirmMoveAsset', 'inputPayload': {'draggedItem': draggedItem, 'droppedItem': droppedItem}}, title='Move Asset?', draggable=True)
	
	return

system.perspective.print("confirmMoveAsset() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	draggedItem = payload['inputPayload']['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
	
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK':

		assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': draggedItem['assetId']}),0)
		assetInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['assetId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
		
		system.perspective.print("Moving %s to parentId %s"%(assetInfo['assetPath'],  assetInfo['parentId']))
		
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.updateAsset(assetInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Asset was not moved. %s'%msg})
		else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Asset has been moved'})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTreeSelector", {'search': ''})

	self.selectAsset(None)
	self.view.custom.assets.refreshTree = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
	
	return

		})

	system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(payload['label'], self.view.custom.security.userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")

system.perspective.print("editGroup() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	if (payload['label'] or None) is None: return
	
	system.kanoa.asset.updateAssetGroup(payload['label'], self.view.custom.assets.selectedAssetInfo.assetGroupId, self.view.custom.security.userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")

system.perspective.print("deleteGroup() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if payload.has_key('userInput') and payload['userInput'] == 'OK':	
		self.deleteGroup()
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")
